I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the contact for the duplicate arrivals on door 6 is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That came from two places Marcus can see. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicates. The public North team cheat sheet lists Thea as QFL's main contact. A contact name is an operational fact, so it's fine to share with Marcus, who is on the North team.
